coverage.design_error_analysis: The output fixes one unspecified model instead of varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B, and fixes learning parameters instead of varying learning rates and KL penalties across training methods. It omits the geometric mean and most specified benchmarks, substitutes additional metrics, and does not specify batch size 128 or sequence length 2048. Gameplay scoring emphasizes generic guessing success rather than attacker-versus-defender win rates.
